from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544931/attempts/5b17e8f43661473aad6b536871505fc9/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            col=g[r][c]
            if col==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and g[yy][xx]==col:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append((col,cells))
    def lshape(cells):
        ys=[y for y,x in cells]; xs=[x for y,x in cells]
        y0,y1=min(ys),max(ys); x0,x1=min(xs),max(xs)
        hh,ww=y1-y0+1,x1-x0+1
        if hh<2 or ww<2 or len(cells)!=hh+ww-1: return False
        # An L has one complete edge row and one complete edge column, sharing a corner.
        s=set(cells)
        for yy in (y0,y1):
            for xx in (x0,x1):
                if all((yy,x) in s for x in range(x0,x1+1)) and all((y,xx) in s for y in range(y0,y1+1)):
                    return True
        return False
    large=[(col,cells) for col,cells in comps if lshape(cells)]
    if not large: return g
    key_col,key=max(large,key=lambda z:len(z[1]))
    # Recolor a smaller, compact L-shaped mark to the color of the large L.
    targets=[(col,cells) for col,cells in comps if col!=key_col and 3<=len(cells)<len(key) and lshape(cells)]
    if targets:
        col,cells=min(targets,key=lambda z:(len(z[1]),z[0]))
        for r,c in cells: g[r][c]=key_col
    return g
'''
